visual_action: From a distance, a man in a dark suit, identified as President Trump by context, walks across a large green lawn toward a helicopter that appears to be Marine One. A young woman joins him, and he puts his arm around her as they walk together. They board the helicopter, which is parked with its doors open. The video concludes with a black-and-white graphic that reads 'THE WHITE HOUSE'.
